answer: Each alias starts on an atlas entry with zero weight, and its standing decays every close unless renewed by verified work inside a paid grading close. Identity is an anchor, not a free float: leaving costs a forfeited exit bond, so abandoning a decayed alias burns value instead of resetting it. A sybil running N aliases pays renewal on each one every epoch; cost grows super-linearly per alias and for any coalition, because decay hits idle members hardest. Newcomers join via a violet-tagged probation quorum of random reviewers, so mass-registration buys nothing until paid work renews it.
